channels.name: GitHub Sponsors for open-source maintainers
channels.dated_status: Public documentation describes contributor sponsorship rather than a guaranteed grant or investment.
channels.eligibility_note: Maintainer account, supported jurisdiction, identity and payout compliance required; project or user's eligibility not checked.
channels.recheck_action: Verify supported jurisdiction, actual contributions, platform account approval and donor interest.

channels.name: Open Collective fiscal sponsorship and shared accounting
channels.dated_status: Open Source Collective invites qualifying projects to apply and advertises 10 percent fiscal-host fee.
channels.eligibility_note: Fiscal hosting enables collection and expenditure administration but is not itself a grant award or committed sponsor.
channels.recheck_action: Verify hosting category, existing legal status, country availability, project verification criteria and fee schedule.

channels.recheck_action: Search specific funding notices and read NOFO applicant, jurisdiction, program and deadline rules before any match.

channels.name: FINDIT Taiwan government-backed startup investment information

channels.recheck_action: Verify applicant legal entity, Taiwan founder/registration status, recent relevant events and investor interest; do not infer a financing commitment.
